data.narrative:
Mendra is a Biotech & Health company founded by Joshua Grass and Lalarukh Shaikh at an undisclosed stage. The valuation universe comprises 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Standard triangulation methods proved inapplicable. Peer-median analysis was not executable: while 7 same-sector peers exist in Biotech & Health, none satisfied narrow stage or valuation-tier filters required for robust comparison (minimum threshold: 3 datapoints). Public-comp anchoring, though feasible in principle—the Biotech & Health sector median trades at 6.2x price-to-sales across the 3 public tickers—cannot be applied without Mendra's disclosed revenue, which is not on file.

Given the absence of applicable triangulation methods and undisclosed current valuation and fundraising history, no quantitative range can be derived from the available data. Further valuation work would require: (i) granular stage and business-metric alignment with the 5 identified private peers, (ii) revenue or comparable revenue-proxy figures for Mendra, or (iii) disclosure of prior fundraising rounds to anchor subsequent rounds. The material uncertainties are stage definition, financial performance metrics, and comparable company selection depth within frontier biotech.
